Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Job Title: 		Commis Cook
Salary range: 	$79,500 - $85,000
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role:
Our client is a beloved artisan bakery renowned for its commitment to traditional baking techniques and high-quality, handcrafted products. With a passion for creating delicious, wholesome breads, pastries, and desserts, they take pride in using time-honoured methods and premium ingredients to deliver exceptional baked goods to their community.

We are seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated Commis Cook to join their dedicated kitchen team. In this role, you will provide essential support in the preparation and production of high-quality baked goods and kitchen items, while maintaining the highest standards of quality, consistency, and food safety. The ideal candidate will have a strong work ethic, a keen willingness to learn, and a passion for the culinary arts.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Food Preparation & Kitchen Support:
• Assist in the preparation, measuring, and weighing of ingredients for breads, pastries, and other bakery items according to exact specifications.
• Perform basic food preparation tasks such as chopping, mixing, and shaping doughs under the guidance of senior kitchen staff.
• Support the monitoring of fermentation and proofing processes for optimal results.

Quality & Service Assistance:
• Help maintain consistent quality by following established recipes and procedures diligently.
• Assist with taste-testing preparations and ensure workstation is stocked and organised.
• Support the packaging and presentation of finished products as required.

Equipment & Workspace Maintenance:
• Conduct thorough cleaning and sanitising of kitchen equipment, work areas, utensils, and baking trays to comply with health and safety regulations.
• Assist in the safe operation and basic maintenance of kitchen machinery and tools.
• Ensure proper storage of ingredients and adherence to stock rotation procedures.

Skills & Requirements:
• Proven 2 years’ full-time experience in related position, with a strong interest in baking/pastry. Bakery experience is highly advantageous.
• Relevant qualification in Commercial Cookery (Certificate III or above) is preferred.
• A foundational understanding of food preparation techniques and kitchen operations.
• Ability to work early mornings, weekends, and public holidays as required in a bakery environment.
• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality food.
• Strong understanding of food safety standards (HACCP) and hygiene best practices.
• Physical stamina to stand for long periods and work in a fast-paced, hot environment.

If you are passionate about food, eager to learn traditional baking techniques, and thrive in a fast-paced, 
hands-on environment, we would love to hear from you! Apply now to be part of a team that takes pride in crafting exceptional products with care and expertise.

Please note: We are acting as the recruitment agent on behalf of our client, and the employer’s identity will be disclosed upon application.

result.description: Cox Purtell Most organisations either have an AI strategist who can't build, or a builder who has no seat at the table. This role offers a rare chance to stay close to the tech, while also having a seat at the table.  A large higher education organisation is bringing in a Head of AI Delivery to own applied AI end to end: shape where it goes, and build the systems that get it there. This is not a hands-off strategy seat, and it is not a pure build seat. It is both, deliberately.   What you'll own:  - Direct input into the organisation's AI roadmap and strategic digital plan - not just executing someone else's - End-to-end delivery of agentic AI, generative AI, LLM and RAG-based systems from concept to production - Establishing the AI capability function from scratch - tooling, delivery patterns, operating model - Mentoring and uplifting existing staff as you build the function around you - Governance, risk, and responsible AI as a core pillar, not an afterthought - transparency, bias mitigation, post-deployment monitoring - Enterprise architecture and cloud platform decisions (Azure, AWS, GCP) - Direct engagement with the CIO, COO, and senior executive leadership   Who you'll report to:  The CIO - technically astute, commercially savvy, and driven to produce outcomes. You'll also be visible to the COO and senior executive leadership. What you build gets seen, and it's expected to demonstrate real value within the first 3-6 months.   What you need:  - You've shipped AI or ML into production before, in a real enterprise - not just a lab or a pilot - You've built or led an AI capability function from the ground up - You've worked hands-on with agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration, not just read about it - RAG, prompt engineering, MLOps/LLMOps - you've actually done this work, not sat in on it - You take governance and responsible AI seriously, in a regulated or genuinely complex environment - You're comfortable being watched by executives and the board, not just your manager   The setup:  - Brisbane-based, hybrid - 2-3 days on-site - Contracted as 12-month fixed-term, but the engagement runs multi-year - real security, not a cliff-edge contract - $180,000-$220,000 plus superannuation - Relocation support available - Standard benefits including leave loading and salary packaging  One non-negotiable: you'll need Australian citizenship or permanent residency for this one.  You'll thrive here if you want both the seat at the table and your hands on the keyboard. You'll struggle here if you only want one or the other - this role won't let you pick.  Want the full brief? Apply below and let's talk.
